mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo, user_id AS userId, user_password AS userPassword, user_email AS userEmail, user_name AS userName, user_birthday AS userBirthday, user_gender AS userGender, user_address AS userAddress, user_detail_address AS userDetailAddress, user_zip_code AS userZipCode, user_phone_number AS userPhoneNumber, user_age AS userAge, user_nickname AS userNickname, user_reg_date AS userRegDate, user_login_date AS userLoginDate, user_photo AS userPhoto, user_role AS userRole, user_iat AS userIat, user_exp AS userExp FROM user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_id, user_password, user_email, user_name, user_birthday, user_gender, user_address, user_detail_address, user_zip_code, user_phone_number, user_age, user_nickname, user_reg_date, user_photo, user_role ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userEmail}, #{userName}, #{userBirthday}, #{userGender}, #{userAddress}, #{userDetailAddress}, #{userZipCode}, #{userPhoneNumber}, #{userAge}, #{userNickname}, NOW(), #{userPhoto}, 'user' )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE user_id = #{id} AND user_password = #{password}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
